{{Quote|Captain. I'm Major Triam, Thirty-fifth Recon. You can stand at ease.|Triam|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Triam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Republic Army]] who led the [[Thirty-fifth Recon]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he was tricked by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Tanno Vik]], who "volunteered" to destroy Imperial jammers in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] but instead disappeared with the explosives. [[Havoc Squad]], in their search for Vik, spoke with Triam and completed Vik's mission.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Triam appears as part of the Trooper class mission "Smash and Grab" on Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]]. He was voiced by [[Tony Armatrading]].<ref name="TOR" />
